# Incident, 30 January

Hermes dropped about 4000 messages.

The operator changed the error code for throttling from 429 to 503 with no
notice. We treat 429 as retryable and 503 as a permanent failure, so every
throttled message was discarded instead of held.

The lesson is not to trust an operator's status codes. Treat any 5xx from them
as retryable and cap the attempts.
